task.outcome_horizon: Five years (to the registration-date anniversary) after date_of_registration; the removal date is observed through the extract date, which is at least seven years later for every eligible cohort.
task.population: Main charities only, where linked_charity_number equals 0, with date_of_registration from 2015-01-01 through 2018-12-31 inclusive, whose charity_registration_status normalises to registered or removed, excluding rows where date_of_removal precedes date_of_registration. One row per organisation_number; linked and subsidiary charities are excluded.
task.prediction_time: date_of_registration, the day the charity is entered on the register. Only attributes present in the current daily extract are treated as registration-time descriptors; classification, area, governing-document and objects fields are not time-stamped, so their as-of-registration availability is assumed rather than verified.
task.question: Will a charity newly entered on the Register of Charities for England and Wales be removed from the register within five years of its registration date?
task.simple_references: Majority-class base rate per split; registration-year base rates as a calendar control; charity_type-only lookup table; no persistence baseline because each charity appears once and the outcome is a first exit event.
task.split_policy: Chronological by date_of_registration: train = registrations from 2015-01-01 through 2016-12-31; eval = 2017-01-01 through 2017-12-31; holdout = 2018-01-01 through 2018-12-31. No embargo is applied because every input is fixed at the row's own registration date and the label is the row's own forward five-year exit; there are no lagged, rolling or cross-row features. All five-year outcome windows close by 2023-12-31, well before the extract date.
task.target: y = 1 if date_of_removal is non-null and is on or before the fifth anniversary of date_of_registration; y = 0 if there is no removal on or before that anniversary, including charities still registered or removed later.
task.usefulness: The label is a forward register-exit event that is never present in the input row, so the model must combine legal form, purpose classification, operating scope and objects text to beat the base rate. Removal includes mergers, asset transfers, dissolution and non-filing, so this is register-exit triage rather than an insolvency or causal effectiveness claim. No existing outcome field is used as a feature.

cross_row_audit.auxiliary_files_review: Only public/train.csv, public/eval.csv and private/holdout.csv are written; no auxiliary evaluation files.
cross_row_audit.rationale: Rows are independent main charities; no cross-row features, label-derived rates or holdout information are shipped.
